data.title: Vietnam vs Pakistan Prediction 2/10/2026 – Odds, Tips & Analysis - Football, head-to-head statistics
data.content:
The opening round brought Vietnam a one-goal victory over the Philippines, but it came at a cost. Nguyen Xuan Son picked up a hamstring injury and was forced to leave the squad. Over the summer he had shared the ASEAN Championship top scorer award with Nguyen Dinh Bac. The regulations do not allow a replacement: the only addition permitted mid-tournament is a goalkeeper. Without him, Vietnam failed to score in their next match. Nguyen Quang Hai and Nguyen Thanh Trung had already been ruled out [...] Vietnam have failed to score more than two goals in six matches in a row. Without Nguyen Xuan Son, who picked up an injury at the start of the tournament, breaking that run will be even harder. In the second round they failed to score at all. So even a comfortable win for the favourites is unlikely to produce a margin of more than two goals. We are not expecting a rout. Our bet is Pakistan to win with a handicap (+2.5). Predicted score: 2-0.
